doubleAttack.name: Double Attack
doubleAttack.desc: Strike the current enemy twice with your melee weapon. Each hit can critically strike. Stops if the enemy dies.

fireStrike.name: Fire Strike
fireStrike.desc: A weak fire spell that deals 15 base damage.

tidalLash.name: Tidal Lash
tidalLash.desc: A lash of seawater that deals 14 base water damage. Cheap on mana.

galeCut.name: Gale Cut
galeCut.desc: A quick blade of wind that deals 9 base air damage, with a short cooldown.

stoneSpike.name: Stone Spike
stoneSpike.desc: A spike of stone that deals 26 base earth damage, with a long cooldown.

thunderstorm.name: Thunderstorm
thunderstorm.desc: A storm that strikes the enemy every 2 seconds for 10 seconds, 8 base air damage per strike. It pauses between enemies and carries on to the next one. Only known while Stormcaller is equipped.

ambush.name: Ambush
ambush.desc: Your next 5 melee hits, auto-attacks and melee spells alike, are guaranteed critical hits.

warCry.name: War Cry
warCry.desc: A roar the stands answer: +25% melee damage for 15 seconds.

volley.name: Volley
volley.desc: Fire three shots at the current enemy with your ranged weapon. Each hit can critically strike. Stops if the enemy dies.
